top_signals.title: 'The House Is Losing': Mike Contopoulos
top_signals.summary: Mike Contopoulos, head of multi-asset macro investing at Janus Henderson, and Kay Herr, US CIO of US GFICC JPMorgan Asset Management, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." This week Treasury Secretary Bessent announced that “I am the house now.” He was talking about the yen, but he also has said he wants yields to be lower. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Mexican Government Slashes Pemex Aid by 70%
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Alex Vasquez joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Mexico's President Claudia Sheinbaum’s proposed 2027 budget reduces support for state-owned oil company Petroleos Mexicanos, pledging 81 billion pesos ($4.8 billion) to help cover its debt payments, down nearly 70% from the amount allocated this year. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
